requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide canonical source loaders for AICtrlWorkflow and AIDataWorkflow roots that reuse substrate parsing and validation and return typed AI workflow definition bindings with structured diagnostics.

case.given: Named XNL sources contain a canonical AICtrlWorkflow root
case.when: The AICtrlWorkflow source loader loads the sources
case.then: The system SHALL return a WorkCtrlFlow-backed AICtrlWorkflow definition binding without diagnostics

case.given: Named XNL sources contain a canonical AIDataWorkflow root
case.when: The AIDataWorkflow source loader loads the sources
case.then: The system SHALL return an EagerDataFlow-backed AIDataWorkflow definition binding without diagnostics

case.given: AI workflow sources contain a wrong root or invalid substrate body
case.when: The corresponding profile loader validates the sources
case.then: The system SHALL return stable structured diagnostics and SHALL NOT fabricate an executable binding
